'''Chandrilan Blue '439''' was a vintage of [[Wine/Legends|wine]] made from [[Chandrilan grappaberry|Chandrilan grappaberries]] grown in vineyards outside the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Nayli]] on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]].<ref name="Strongholds" /> It was [[Diet/Legends|drinkable]] by [[Human/Legends|Humans]].<ref name="CNI" />

The most well-known vintage of Chandrilan wine,<ref name="Strongholds" /> a bottle of Chandrilan Blue '439 was served alongside grilled [[t'surys]] with [[spongewort]] garnish to the Human [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jax Pavan]] while he hid out with the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Rokko]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] in the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant underworld]] during the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]]<ref name="CNI" /> in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Coruscant Nights I: Jedi Twilight]]'', which includes the meal served to [[Jax Pavan]], to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Chandrilan Blue '439 was first mentioned in ''[[Coruscant Nights I: Jedi Twilight]]'', a [[2008]] novel written by [[Michael Reaves]] as the first installment of the ''[[Star Wars: Coruscant Nights]]'' trilogy.<ref name="CNI" />
